_readme: Affiliate tracking for outbound ticket links. Both programs run on impact.com and track with a wrapped redirect, not a query parameter. Once approved, Impact gives you a tracking link per program; paste it into 'wrap' with {url} where the destination goes (Impact calls this the 'u' parameter). Empty 'wrap' = links pass through untouched. Rules match the ticket URL's host, first match wins. Applied to every generated page and injected into index.html on each build.
